review_findings: The plan fills Provider effect implementations below the existing Resolver, Dispatcher, and WriteAuthorityGuard rather than adding peer authorities.
Workspace state transitions use a closed operation list with path and digest preconditions; no runtime shell string is accepted.
Git commit identity is bound to exact parent and paths, while GitHub PR identity is bound to repository, branches, and a verification read of exact head SHA.
GitHub credentials are an effect prerequisite only and never become repository write, merge, quality, or completion authority.
The bootstrap deliberately omits automatic merge and preserves TaskRun VALIDATING at Graph END.
The real model-driven Skill Host remains injected because repository Python cannot impersonate ChatGPT/Codex Skill execution.
